excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Phase Three — Tiferes: Exact Execution Plan The Awtsmoos renews every page and every packet before a selector or handler can claim a separate throne; Awtsmoos.com will become futuristic by discipline first—each local root sovereign, each interaction complete, each API pathway known. searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase three — tiferes: exact execution plan the awtsmoos renews every page and every packet before a selector or handler can claim a separate throne; awtsmoos.com will become futuristic by discipline first—each local root sovereign, each interaction complete, each api pathway known. auth reference implementation files to rewrite completely style/auth/tokens.css — move all auth variables from :root to .login page; add semantic success/warning/danger/focus/state tokens. style/auth/base.css — replace raw , html, body, body::before, bh ownership with .login page rooted equivalents only. style/auth/card.css — root every shell/card/heading selector; keep atmosphere clipped inside auth page. style/auth/fields.css — remove raw form; root fields; add autofill, readonly, disabled, invalid, placeholder and focus within state contracts. style/auth/actions.css — root every action; capability gate hover; preserve active/focus visible; add disabled/busy cursor/state semantics. style/auth/status.css — root status/busy selectors; add semantic status data state affordances without requiring js changes. style/auth/responsive.css — root responsive and reduced motion selectors; add forced colors fallback if kept here or split to accessibility. style/auth/authuxcontract.test.mjs — reject known global selectors, verify root scoping, hover media gate, state coverage, import coverage, and file budgets. files to retain unless evidence requires change style/forms.css — existing high level manifest is valid if nested control imports stay explicit; rewrite only to improve covenant/ordering if status stays clean. style/auth/controls.css — nested manifest already separates fields/actions/status; preserve unless import contract changes. login/index.html / register/index.html — already expose the stable .login page root; do not rewrite server logic during css wave. shared future system follow up re run existing future system contract. audit all selectors for root sovereignty. add a page root adoption contract rather than global injection. build an interaction state detector test shared across future system adopters. extend controller jsdocs only by splitting modules when needed; never shrink documentation to satisfy 120 lines. js/api follow up inventory page level fetch( / xhr / request wrappers. cluster by repeated behavior: json parsing, auth failure, loading state, abort, retries, status mapping. extract one small request result vocabulary only where actual duplication is proven. keep renderer dom code separate from transport and state. require each touched function to document @description, every @param, @returns, thrown/rejected/error semantics, side effects, and lifecycle ownership. verification order 1. fresh exact path git status immediately before auth writes. 2. whole file auth css rewrites only. 3. readback all auth css files. 4. run auth contract test and source line budget checks. 5. browser login/register at narrow + desktop widths. 6. keyboard/focus/autofill/invalid/disabled simulation where browser tooling permits. 7. only then generalize the sovereignty contract to the next page families. next action run the fresh auth path ownership check, then execute the complete auth css rewrite wave before tests.

title: Phase One — Limitless Relationship Brainstorm
excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Phase One — Limitless Relationship Brainstorm The Awtsmoos is beyond follower and followed, yet Awtsmoos.com may reveal every social edge as a truthful beam: quick to inspect, safe to change, clear to the eye, and never duplicated into five drifting client stories. Every possibility One
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase one — limitless relationship brainstorm the awtsmoos is beyond follower and followed, yet awtsmoos.com may reveal every social edge as a truthful beam: quick to inspect, safe to change, clear to the eye, and never duplicated into five drifting client stories. every possibility one canonical relationship status read for any acting alias and typed target. existing follow/unfollow writes remain the only mutation authority. profile buttons never scan five pages merely to learn one boolean. network collections stay authoritative list views rather than client caches. people remains public discovery unless a future batch relationship contract is proven. future relationship truth may include mutuality, notifications, timestamps, and recommendation relevance only when backend evidence exists. mutation state remains explicit and duplicate clicks remain blocked. identity/profile target changes reject stale relationship responses. logged out and self profile paths avoid needless requests. competing architectures a. global relationship cache — rejected: too much invalidation for one current point read consumer. b. infer from network list — rejected: bounded pages and route dependent loading. c. social kernel relation — rejected today: follows exists semantically but has storagekind: null. d. new relationship storage — rejected: existing follow storage is canonical and bounded. e. point read beside /follows/:alias — chosen: one request, no migration, no invented truth.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two — realistic relationship architecture the awtsmoos gives chesed the dream and gevurah the measured edge; awtsmoos.com should strengthen the living relationship graph by strengthening its proven owner. evidence profilefollowcontroller currently scans offsets 0..800 by 200, potentially five sequential requests and 1,000 records. socialgraphapi follow/unfollow responses are opaque to callers and should not be treated as relation snapshots. networkpanel is authoritative on load and read only. peoplepanel renders discovery cards without follow state. profile reloads after successful mutation. backend follow storage is /social/aliases/{alias}/following, one array bounded to 1,000 records. social kernel intentionally marks semantic follows as non persisted. chosen implementation 1. add a pure point status helper beside existing profile follow functions. 2. add a specific get status route beside /follows/:alias. 3. keep list/follow/unfollow routes unchanged. 4. add one frontend socialgraphapi method and socialhubapi delegate. 5. rewrite profilefollowcontroller to make exactly one relationship status request. 6. preserve request sequence stale protection, self/logged out behavior, mutation disable state, and post mutation profile reconciliation. no new storage keys. no global cache. no fake mutual state.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two critique — twenty five improvements the awtsmoos renews the edge before the edge can boast; awtsmoos.com therefore questions every shortcut until the smallest truthful contract remains. 1. reuse current target normalization. 2. reject missing target ids explicitly. 3. point reads never mutate timestamps. 4. one db read only. 5. do not read reverse follower index when forward storage answers the question. 6. preserve typed targets. 7. preserve public following list readability. 8. do not invent authentication requirements for a currently public edge list. 9. never expose user ids. 10. return a small data object, not the whole list. 11. keep old pagination unchanged. 12. keep old mutations unchanged. 13. keep profile stale request rejection. 14. keep button disabled during writes. 15. reconcile after mutation from canonical profile load. 16. surface mutation/reconciliation failures honestly. 17. test false relationship. 18. test true relationship. 19. test typed target normalization. 20. test missing target. 21. test frontend route encoding and envelope unwrap. 22. test profile controller one request behavior. 23. keep every touched file below 120 lines by splitting. 24. update docs only after behavior is proven. 25. continue automatically to discovery/query cancellation after closure.

title: Phase Three — Thirty Further Corrections
excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Phase Three — Thirty Further Corrections The Awtsmoos is beyond first plan and second plan; Awtsmoos.com lets the third light expose where elegance could accidentally become invention. 1. awtsmoos.profile.js is already 136 lines; touching it requires modular split, never comment shaving.
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase three — thirty further corrections the awtsmoos is beyond first plan and second plan; awtsmoos.com lets the third light expose where elegance could accidentally become invention. 1. awtsmoos.profile.js is already 136 lines; touching it requires modular split, never comment shaving. 2. prefer a focused relationship route module composed into profile routes. 3. preserve every existing profile route key. 4. verify more specific status routing does not conflict with /follows/:alias. 5. encode frontend path segments. 6. normalize again on server. 7. keep status read public unless current graph policy says otherwise. 8. do not use social kernel follows yet. 9. do not infer mutuality. 10. do not add badges to people without batch support. 11. do not reload hidden network gratuitously. 12. no new db keys. 13. no storage migration. 14. no event bus. 15. no optimistic relationship cache. 16. keep mutation response compatibility. 17. keep list response compatibility. 18. keep target notification metadata semantics. 19. keep follow count caps. 20. point status returns boolean plus normalized target only. 21. search external helper imports before deleting old scanner utility. 22. preserve exported helper if outside callers exist. 23. give every rewritten function full jsdoc. 24. replace compressed touched callbacks with named functions. 25. keep tests below 120 by shared witnesses, never compression. 26. run syntax before behavioral tests. 27. run full social baseline after focused tests. 28. reread every touched file. 29. update remaining work and docs. 30. continue into discovery/search cancellation once this edge is closed.
